seo.title: FlyFrame vs Visafoto: Feature Comparison | FlyFrame
seo.description: A side-by-side look at FlyFrame and Visafoto for passport and visa photos: countries, editing, checks, pricing, privacy and more, based on Visafoto's own public pages.

hero.title: flyFrame vs Visafoto
hero.intro: Compare FlyFrame and Visafoto for passport and visa photos. Explore their features, photo requirements, verification, pricing, and key differences.

cards.name: FlyFrame
cards.paragraph: FlyFrame is planned as a passport and visa photo editor for 100+ countries, built around precise, rule-locked editing, a live camera guide, a free photo checker and a phone handoff.
cards.text: Rule-locked crop frame, live camera guide, free checker, desktop-to-phone handoff.

cards.name: Visafoto
cards.paragraph: Visafoto is a live service that processes photos automatically and states a price, a refund promise and a long list of document types. On the pages we read, it describes automatic cropping and a "Fix head tilt" option.
cards.text: Automatic processing, a stated price, a full-refund promise and many document types.

flyframe.heading: FlyFrame
points: Rule-locked crop frame with guide lines, live colour feedback and hard export limits.
Live camera guide with a level indicator that auto-captures once every check passes.
Free photo checker reports pass or fail on size, head height, blur and lighting first.
QR code phone handoff, so laptop users can shoot on their phone and finish on desktop.
Official source and last-checked date shown on every country page.

competitor.heading: Visafoto
points: Live today, with many countries and document types, including the US, UK, Canada and India.
Clear $9 price for a digital photo, and a full-refund promise if a photo is rejected.
No registration needed, and it accepts both images and PDFs up to 15 MB per file.
Many background colours, a head tilt fix, and automatic lighting fixes on paid orders.
States a 99.7% pass rate and rejections under 1% of orders, though we haven't verified it.
